name: W8000 - Shared Folders Governance
description: Intent: Warn-tier user dialog on Shared Folder copy / move / download into the Unauthorized shared-folder surface at sensitivity floor [2] — prompts the user before sensitive content is moved into non-sanctioned network shares. Exclusions: excludes paths in File_Paths_Authorized_Internal_Network_Share_[starts_with] and File_Paths_Authorized_External_Network_Share_[starts_with]; tune both Authorized share lists so legitimate file-server work doesn't warn users.
